This deck is fun for you, and hell for your opponent.

== Strategy ==

Get knowledge of your opponent´s deck using Scanning Crew and A Dangerous Time. Remove Rebels from light side´s hand to his used pile with Scanning Crew, and if you have a Close Call in you hand, play the lost version to make the rebel lost. Use Defensive Fire to remove more cards from light side´s hand, and to reduce his hand to 2 cards so you can play your nasty Limited Resources. Reorder his force pile using A Dangerous Time (put his the best cards at the top of the pile), making him miss the best cards as he use them as force, alternatively put his interrupt cards at the top of the force pile (remember the name(s) of the interrupt card(s)!), making them ending up in his used pile, so you can play Voyeur, resulting in him losing force or the interreupt card(s) you name.

Force drain at Hoth, Endor and Tatooine, use Elis Helrot to move around. This deck has a lousy average destiny of 3. So make sure you have a Takeel at hand, and 1 force in your force pile if theres gonna be a battle.
